Top-down view of an emptied Korean apartment floor of warm honey-colored wooden planks, late-afternoon sunlight falling through window blinds in long diagonal golden stripes, dust motes glowing in the beams. On the left, a stack of numbered moving boxes (13 to 19) with handwritten numbers. In the center, an open cardboard box labeled '12 · 안방 장롱 위' holding an unworn white baby gown on tissue paper; a cassette tape labeled '엄마 목소리 '94' lies on the floor nearby, faint italic whispers of thought floating beside objects. The player's pointer hand lifts a newborn hospital wristband dated 1968 with a soft drop shadow, a dotted golden guide curve leading down to a glowing empty slot on a life timeline along the bottom: a thin golden thread from 1941 to 2025 with small polaroid-style keepsake photos pinned above and below it and dashed empty slots marked '?'. Minimal serif HUD top-left: '12 / 30'. Painterly, quiet, tender, warm honey, ash and paper tones, soft film grain and vignette. Text constraints: the floating whispers are Korean only (e.g. "작은 시작이었어", "아직 들려"), no English sentences anywhere. Timeline photos match her age in each year: the 1941 slot shows a newborn baby photo, a young woman appears only from the 1960s on, and an elderly woman only after 2000.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same apartment floor at blue hour, now almost completely empty: faint pale rectangles on the wooden planks where boxes used to stand, cold lavender moonlight stripes through the blinds, sparse drifting dust. In the center, the thirtieth and last cardboard box sits open, empty except for a small brass house key tied with string to a paper tag handwritten in blue ink '다 보셨으면 열쇠는 우편함에. 고마워요.', a tiny glint of warm light on the key. Below it, a woman's name finally revealed in large, widely spaced light serif letters '윤순례' with '1941 — 2025'. Along the bottom, the complete life timeline: the golden thread now glowing brightly, every slot filled with small polaroid keepsakes — school photo, factory badge, wedding ring, baby wristband, letters, cassette, potted plant, senior bus pass, the key. Minimal HUD top-left '30 / 30'. Painterly, elegiac, deep indigo and slate with a single warm gold accent, soft grain, gentle vignette.
